spec_match.rationale: Positions recognised segments on an audio timeline from audioStartTime/audioEndTime — the feature's canonical use — with null-timed captions flagged as unpositioned rather than guessed.

interactive.rationale: Start-listening, sample-walkthrough and clear all work; the sample renders a fully-timed transcript so the page is useful without a backend (final clear explains the unchanged text diff in this run).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Click-to-seek/karaoke framing matches what the timeline shows.

edge_cases.rationale: Null timing, mic denial and the unpositioned-caption path are all handled and labelled.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite blocked (8/8) — honest for a mic-gated API.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Sample walkthrough produced the timed transcript; live branch surfaced the real not-allowed error; console clean.

accessibility.rationale: Controls named, captions listed textually alongside the visual timeline, aria-live outputs.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. The sample walkthrough keeps the page demonstrative without a speech backend; live branch honest.
